institution_name: UNIFASE Petrópolis - Faculdade de Medicina de Petrópolis

coverage.notes: FMP is the Petrópolis medical school; its directly entered first professional degree is the six-year, full-time Medicina/Médico. The official medical directory’s indexed programme record lists Portuguese instruction, while FMP’s official IB recognition entry lists English and Spanish as institution-level full-degree languages. The conflict and absence of a programme-specific 2027 English-medium track preclude listing any English-taught first-year programme. Other degrees advertised under UNIFASE are not automatically FMP medical-school programmes. Programmes intentionally empty pending confirmation; not an assertion that English entry is impossible.

institution.summary: Faculdade de Medicina de Petrópolis (FMP), the medical school within UNIFASE/FMP, in Petrópolis, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

claims.statement: Faculdade de Medicina de Petrópolis (FMP) is the medical college within the UNIFASE/FMP higher-education institutional grouping, in Petrópolis, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The university-centre name is Centro Universitário Arthur Sá Earp Neto (UNIFASE); FMP is the named medical school, not a second campus in another city.

conflicts.explanation: The World Directory of Medical Schools lists the FMP Médico first degree in Portuguese, whereas the IB recognition profile labels languages of full-degree programmes at institution level as English and Spanish. The profiles may describe different scopes (FMP Medicine versus wider UNIFASE degrees), or one may contain an error. The first source’s detailed record was obtained through indexed full-page content rather than a successful direct-open fetch.
conflicts.next_step: Seek written official FMP curriculum/teaching-language confirmation or an up-to-date 2027.1 IB/Medicine edital explicitly identifying the language and all available first-year tracks; check the live World Directory and request correction to the university IB profile if applicable.
